text: Very good service! The doctor spoke very well english, they have an x-ray so if needed it takes minutes. They work with our insurance company so it was a smooth process. Everyone was very kind and the facilities were nicely clean.

My girlfriend's tooth chipped off and these professionals were able to help out quickly. We got an appointment the same day and Dentist Pimpatchawan Siriritikrai helped us out. She was very thorough and the result is perfect. The lady at the reception went above expectations helping us out with our insurance paperwork. She even brought out an envelope to put these papers away safely when we were outside already. 5 star experience!

Excellent service!! Cleaning only this time, it was done carefully and gently, but at the same time really efficiently and thoroughly. My first time in this place, the  very professional and kind dentist I think I've met before. Reception/cashier, all staff, nice premises... all just kind and helpful. Surely will come back. Highly recommended!!

Whilst on holiday in Krabi my wisdom tooth cracked in half which was causing extreme pain. I found Dental Room Krabi whilst searching online for a dentist, It had some great reviews plus my hotel recommended them when I asked their advice.
My appointment was booked for an hour after the phone call. When I arrived the staff were extremely helpful and spoke good English.
The practice was also nice and clean.
Once I went in to see the dentist she did an X-Ray and advised me that the tooth needed extraction, which she did there and then (I didn't feel a thing). I was also given plenty of paracetamol and ibuprofen to take away with me.
The total cost was much lower than what we have to pay with the NHS in the UK.
I can not thank them all enough for their help, it saved my holiday.

I visited Dental Room Krabi and had a very positive experience.
Dr. Taow is professional, kind, and very gentle. She explained every step clearly, which made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the treatment.
The clinic is clean, well-organized, and the overall service is excellent.
I highly recommend the clinic, especially Dr. Taow. Thank you for the great care!

I highly recommend this dental clinic. The staff at the front were very friendly. I called and booked an appointment for 5pm and they saw me right at the scheduled time, there was no wait time at all.

I needed teeth cleaning since it had been over a year since my last dentist visit. The dentist at this clinic was very professional and much gentler than my dentist back home. I was in and out in under 30 minutes and my teeth have never felt cleaner 🦷😊
Was recommended here by my local dentist for a new crown. Great doctor, who speaks perfect English and I am very happy with my new crown. All prices are posted in their book

I highly recommend this dental office where I received a superlative treatment (in my case cleaning and whitening of the teeth plus a dozen collars), I am sure that in my life I have never had such beautiful, clean and perfect teeth only after being treated in this practice.

I also wanted to emphasise the excellent quality/price ratio and the welcome of all the staff from the first to the last where they were able to take care of me from the beginning to the end

To sum it, highly recommended and 5 stars are not enough ❤️

My service was a Dental cleaning.
- The doctor did a great job cleaning deeply, she was fully focused and attentive to my sensitivity.
- Booking and communication was efficient, I booked from Europe through email and no problems at all.
- Price: 30Eur which is great for the high quality implemented, instruments and location.
They are brilliant! Very helpful and convenient location. I had a tooth emergency and they were able to see me on the same day. Very clean, very professional and great service!

Came here for dental cleaning and airflow. Was overall VERY happy with my experience here. The location is very clean and modern. Dentist and staff were super attentive to my needs. The dentist in particular was very thorough and gentle. …

I was traveling in Thailand and looking for a dentist for a teeth cleaning. The lady dentist is incredibly skilled, gentle, caring, and highly professional. I’ve never experienced such a pleasant and reassuring dental treatment before. Without a doubt, the best dentist I’ve ever met. A big thank you for the high-quality care and the warm welcome. I 100% recommend this place!

If you're looking for a trustworthy very experienced,  affordable , and very helpful competent dentist in Thailand?  You arrived on the right page!
I felt a little lost searching for the right place,  traveling for far away,  investing lots of money.
But from the communication through whatsapp ( So helpful n effective) from day 1, they were able to help for all the steps efficiently.
I did an implant, 4 veneers and a filling. All jobs were perfectly done. I'm very grateful .
Throughout the whole process they were gentle,  caring. With a good English communication.
And something very important to consider is that they charge the same for locals and foreigners,  which shows a lot on how valuable they are,  both on human and professional qualities.
I  clearly recommend this clinic,  no doubt!

I brought the kids for teeth cleaning and the service was beyond excellent! Dr Mint was so patient and meticulous with her careful cleaning! If you need this, don’t hesitate! The kids and the whole family at large are very happy!
Thanks Dr Mint! So fresh!

American traveller here. My filling came out while flossing here in Krabi, and I was able to get into an appointment next day.  I waited only 5 minutes to be seen by a Thai Dentist fluent in English, and he walked me through what he saw and what he was going to do.

I was in and out without NOx or
anesthetic in less than thirty minutes with a new filling for ~$33.00, amazing.

Would highly recommend if you are in need of dentistry while in Krabi.

text: We had an emergency and immediately got an appointment, she was very understanding and did a great job, would recommend!

Lovely dentist! I came here because my teeth were really sensitive when eating while staying in Krabi and they managed to book me in the next day for a check up. They determined quickly what was wrong and sorted me out there and then for very reasonable prices. Would recommend for any tourist with tooth emergencies.

I can highly recommend the dentist and her team. I needed dental help at the weekend because of an emergency. Communication in English via WhatsApp and Facebook (Messenger) was quick and easy. The doctor was directly available on Saturday evening. I was able to make an appointment at the practice straight away. The team is super friendly. The doctor is professional and explains the treatment very well in English. The practice has modern equipment. It's a pity that the Dental Room Krabi team doesn't work in Bonn (Germany), I would go straight to this dentist and her team.
Fast, efficient and very professional service. Very highly recommended.

I was in Thailand for a holiday last year and extended it with a plan to get dentistry done. Dental Room came up as highly recommended. Walked in late one afternoon, it had a small but cosy and clean front room with welcoming staff. They did my check-up the next day and was booked for an appointment 2 days later.

All staff I met were friendly and professional, they did an incredible job of translating the work I needed done to English. The dentistry was done at a good price and nearly a year later I can attest to its quality! Sorry for the late review, thank you all very much Krabi Dental Room!

Came here for teeth cleaning and to get two fillings done. The dentist was very gentle and my teeth cleaning turned out better than at home. They also managed to see me the same afternoon which was great. The place is super super clean, prices are really competitive and everyone is really professional. I visited another dentist first and they claimed I needed a lot more work, this place won’t try to oversell you on anything - they just genuinely want to help you. Thoroughly recommend, especially for any travellers who only have a short amount of time in Krabi.

I got my tooth removed today. Everything went so good. I am very scared of dental treatments but Dental room team were amazing. Very professional, very calm, rush free! I recommend them highly to everyone!

Fantastic service. I went in the ask for a checkup. They gave me an appointment in 30 minutes. I'd normally have to wait weeks for an appointment back in the UK.

The dentist was very good. I've been having some bleeding after brushing. She diagnosed plaque and gave my teeth a thorough cleaning. Total cost was only 820 baht.

It was a little hard to understand her English but I just asked her to write it down and then I could understand perfectly 👍.

Highly recommend going here. I didn't even intend on going to a dentist while on holiday but just saw this place and it turned out well.

Dental Room Krabi is a great dental clinic. Not only was the price of their work great (about 1/3 of the price in Australia) but the care and quality was better than I had received in Australia previously. …

Extremely good dentist with all facilities and ultra modern equipment. They replaced a filling that had fallen out. Got a quick appointment on a Sunday morning! I didn't even need an injection as the procedure was so gentle. The price was very good too. Only 700 Baht.
Highly recommended. Thank you.

We had a problem with my daughter's braces while on vacation in phi phi island iin April 2025. We wee able to book by phone the evening  before taking the ferry to kraby,and they allow us before going to the airport. Undestilood immediately the problem and solve it very professionally. And the price was extremely honest. Reccomended!

I landed in Krabi with a broken tooth from a boiled sweet. I contacted this dentist after having read her excellent reviews  I was given an appointment later that day. Whilst I asked for a temporary dressing to see me through I was offered a permanent rebuild which was carried out quickly cheaply and painlessly. I can not recommend too highly.

The people of Thailand surprise me every time with their kindness and willingness to help. But what I got at the Dental Room Krabi clinic has raised that conviction to a higher level. Although I did not have a big problem, only a minor intervention, they accepted me with great affection. Within an hour, they removed all the problems in a very efficient way.
Everyone in the clinic spoke English well enough. The office is newly fitted with all the instruments and meets the high standards. In short, you can move it to any corner of Europe and will work as well. The doctor is a special story, in her hands I felt so safe that I could fall asleep in the chair. After treatment she took some time to advise me what to do when I get back to Croatia. it suffices to say that she cares about the patients and when they are not her patients.
Price is for the opportunities of Western Europe funny. even slightly smaller than Croatian prices.
if that clinic is located in Croatia, I would definitely have chosen her for my personal. So, if you are near Krabi and have problems with your teeth, I highly recommend that you visit them. I can not say how other clinics are, but this one deserves all five stars.
Best regards, Vrana

I cracked my tooth on the plane eating some crunchy snack I was worried so I found this place on google such great reviews I’m happy I came here so professional and everything was very clean. He was able to do a tooth colored filling to protect it and I was only charged $35 what an amazing deal! Back home this would be $600. Basically my trip here paid for my flight I plan on coming back next week to fix my other tooth.

text: I highly recommend Dr Nat at the Dental Room Krabi!! My 70 year old mum holidaying here unfortunately snapped a filling out of her front tooth whilst eating food off a stick, and had an unsightly gap in our holiday photos. After looking at the reviews we called and booked in an appointment within 24 hours. We travelled over 45 from Ao Nang into Krabi town (closer ones were available but these reviews swayed it) and had a short wait to be seen by Dr Nat. She was so polite and professional, explaining what she was going to do and why, and even gave further advice on another tooth to get looked at by our UK dentist at home after our holiday. The whole experience was so wonderful, pain free, and very reasonably priced (£28 for half a tooth’s worth of filling). The filling looks flawless and as if it’s her natural tooth. The cherry on top was when we were back in our hotel at Ao Nang beach having gone out to dinner, Dr Nat happened to be meeting friends at our very own hotel and came up to us to check if we were ok and needed any assistance! So lovely. Brilliant dentist, we are very grateful to you Dr Nat.

Great experience! Spoke good English and didn’t give me any treatment I didn’t need. Great advice and found the cause of my toothache. Got teeth cleaned for 700baht. Excellent service, very clean - sterile equipment and room, very modern. Thank you so much!

I made a appointment here 3 weeks before  due to my friend recommendation and reviews than come from looong way  but unfortunately my situation is too complicated for them and  instead of owner/dentist lady , there was another lady dentist …
5 star review for 5 new fillings (& and cleaning). Great experience, much needed, very happy. Thanks to the staff for taking care of me. My endorsement!

Arrived in Thailand and my crown broke, so I knew I would be in Krabi and googled this place. Very responsive with my Facebook messages and went and got the crown fix for 1000 baht. Lovely kind dentist which makes the experience even better. Highly recommend
I broke a piece of tooth, very fast appointment,  and very good work, doctor Ployy very nice, patient, good work.  I am happy to find this clinic

Fantastic service, quick response, and professional. Wish I had this kind of hospitality from dentist offices back in Canada. Regular cleaning is 600-1000baht and full deep cleaning is 600-1000baht per quadrant.
Got teeth whitening, they have the pola light technology, it was very professional
Very good dentist, has a very good English. I had my teeth cleaned and the service was perfect. Thanks!
My crown broke and I went here to fix it. Got a temporary fix for 1k. Fast and effective treatment. Nice and friendly dentist. Considering going back for more treatment
Very good experience needed a deep cleaning two injections and felt almost no pain out in an hour teeth cleaned and only cost 28$

text:
This is the best dentist I know. The doctor(Mint) is very gentle. She speaks very good English and takes her time. I had no pain at all.
Thank you!
The staff provided excellent service. Dr. Mint and her assistant were kind, polite, and didn't put any pressure on me. I made the right decision to use their services.

While on vacation in Krabi, I lost a large piece of my upper front tooth and decided to have it treated here.
The place was very clean and the staff spoke excellent English.
After almost 1.5 hours of surgery, the missing piece and all the other cavities that had formed earlier were filled and the result is completely flawless.
I can recommend this place to anyone
I had a very good and professional care here.

We experienced an acute inflammation of a wisdom tooth and quickly got an emergency appointment at the Daniel Room dental clinic. The treatment was professional, and the staff was both very helpful and accommodating.

The treatment itself went very well, and we would like to send a big thank you to the staff for their courtesy, friendliness and high level of professionalism. We can highly recommend this
Very professional service, highly recommended
Honestly, they're not thieves; they're very honest with you. Despite the language barrier, as I don't speak English, they were very understanding, and we used Google.
Excellent service! The doctor was very gentle and the procedure was completed quickly. Extremely professional! 🥰 …
The service from the staff was wonderful. The doctors were all very kind and gentle, especially Dr. Mint. I highly recommend them.
